properties.description: Runs one DIRECT Batch: opens the instances in the repository, runs the Module executables on the Warehouse in sequence, closes the instances with the outcome. Configured by the DIRECT Variable Library.

activities.name: Open Batch
activities.description: Creates and evaluates the Batch Instance and the Module Instances with omd.CreateBatchModuleInstances; returns the Modules to run.

activities.name: Run Modules
activities.description: Runs the rollback statements and executables of the Modules on the Warehouse, in sequence, and collects the outcome per Module Instance.

activities.name: Close Batch
activities.description: Reports the Module results to omd.EndBatchModuleInstances and closes the Batch Instance.

activities.name: Fail Batch
activities.description: Closes the Batch Instance as Failure when the Modules could not be run.
